data.standardized_narrative: Unable to locate an explicit gross (insurance liabilities) prioryear reserve movement figure in the available images. Opening gross claims outstanding for the start of the year (31 Dec 2017 column in the Statement of Financial Position: Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) was read as 507.0 (millions, native currency). The report contains claims development/claims tables (a gross triangle) and extensive notes, but a clear labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross amount was not legibly extractable from the provided images; accordingly prior year development is not reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction performed from provided page images (rotated scans). OCR/text parsing of the PDF failed; values were read visually and are therefore approximate. Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities - Claims outstanding) prior year comparative column (interpreted as 507.0). No unambiguous GROSS prioryear movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could be reliably identified in the scanned images: movement notes and narrative text present in the file could not be read with confidence or showed net (after reinsurance) amounts only. The report does include a gross claims development triangle (page 30) but the triangle numeric cells could not be transcribed accurately enough to compute a robust prior year development figure; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
